verses.en: Canst thou draw out leviathan with an hook? or his tongue with a cord which thou lettest down?
verses.sm: Atua ia Iopu E te mafaia ea ona sisi o leviatana i se mātau, pe taomi lona laulaufaiva i se maea?

verses.en: Canst thou put an hook into his nose? or bore his jaw through with a thorn?
verses.sm: E te mafaia ea ona tuu se maea i lona isu? pe tui lona auvae i se matau?

verses.en: Will he make many supplications unto thee? will he speak soft words unto thee?
verses.sm: Na te faateleina ea ni tatalo ia te oe? pe tautala faaoleole ia te oe?

verses.en: Will he make a covenant with thee? wilt thou take him for a servant for ever?
verses.sm: Lua te osi ea se feagaiga ma ia? E te avea ea o ia e fai ma auauna e faavavau?

verses.en: Wilt thou play with him as with a bird? or wilt thou bind him for thy maidens?
verses.sm: Lua te taaalo ea ma 1a e pei o se manu lele? pe e te nonoa ia te ia mo outou teine?

verses.en: Shall the companions make a banquet of him? shall they part him among the merchants?
verses.sm: pe fai a‘i ea se tausamiga e uo? Latou te tufatufa atu ea ia te ia i e faatauoa?

verses.en: Canst thou fill his skin with barbed irons? or his head with fish spears?
verses.sm: E te mafaia ea ona velosia ia lilo lona pau i mea maamaai? ma lona ulu i tao sofa iʻa?

verses.en: Lay thine hand upon him, remember the battle, do no more.
verses.sm: Tuu atu ia lou lima i luga ia te la, la manatua le taua; e te le toe faia.

verses.en: Behold, the hope of him is in vain: shall not one be cast down even at the sight of him?
verses.sm: Faauta, E fai fua le faamoemoe e maua ia; e le pau ea foi se tasi i le vaai atu ia te ia?

verses.en: None is so fierce that dare stir him up: who then is able to stand before me?
verses.sm: E leai se na te faamalosi e faatei ia te ia. O ai foi se tu mai i oʻu luma?

verses.en: Who hath prevented me, that I should repay him? whatsoever is under the whole heaven is mine.
verses.sm: O ai se na muai aumaia ni mea ia te au, ou te toe taui atu ai? O mea uma lava o i lalo o le lagi o au mea ia.

verses.en: I will not conceal his parts, nor his power, nor his comely proportion.
verses.sm: Ou te le natia ona itu tino, ma le tala i lona malosi, ma le matagofie o lona ofutau.

verses.en: Who can discover the face of his garment? or who can come to him with his double bridle?
verses.sm: O ai se susue lona ofu aupito i tua? O ai se oo atu i ona atu nifo e lua?

verses.en: Who can open the doors of his face? his teeth are terrible round about.
verses.sm: O ai se tatala puipui o lona gutu? E matautia ona atu nifo faataaliolio.

verses.en: His scales are his pride, shut up together as with a close seal.
verses.sm: E maeu le malosi o ona talita, ua punimau i le faamaufaailoga.

verses.en: One is so near to another, that no air can come between them.
verses.sm: Ua sosoo le tasi i le tasi, e le sao le savili i o latou va.

verses.en: They are joined one to another, they stick together, that they cannot be sundered.
verses.sm: Ua fepiitai le tasi i le tasi, ua fesootai, ua le mafai ona faatea eseese.

verses.en: By his neesings a light doth shine, and his eyes are like the eyelids of the morning.
verses.sm: O ona mafatua ua pupula ai le malamalama; o ona mata foi e pei o laumata o le taeao.

verses.en: Out of his mouth go burning lamps, and sparks of fire leap out.
verses.sm: E o atu sulu ai lona gutu, e oso mai ai aloiafi.

verses.en: Out of his nostrils goeth smoke, as out of a seething pot or caldron.
verses.sm: E alu atu le asu ai ona pogaiisu e pei o se pani ua tapili i ai le afi, po o se ulo ua vevela.

verses.en: His breath kindleth coals, and a flame goeth out of his mouth.
verses.sm: O lana mánava e mu ai malala, e alu atu foi le afi mumu ai lona gutu.

verses.en: In his neck remaineth strength, and sorrow is turned into joy before him.
verses.sm: E i ai le malosi i lona ua, e saa foi le mata‘u i ona luma.

verses.en: The flakes of his flesh are joined together: they are firm in themselves; they cannot be moved.
verses.sm: Ua maopoopo le aano o lona manava; ua maaa lea, e le mafaagaeetia.

verses.en: His heart is as firm as a stone; yea, as hard as a piece of the nether millstone.
verses.sm: Ua maaa lona fatumanava e pei o se maa, ua maaa lava e pei o se maaolo aupito i lalo.

verses.en: When he raiseth up himself, the mighty are afraid: by reason of breakings they purify themselves.
verses.sm: A tulai o ia, ona fefefe ai lea o toa; ua sese i latou ina ua matautuia.

verses.en: The sword of him that layeth at him cannot hold: the spear, the dart, nor the habergeon.
verses.sm: E taututa le pelu o le faasaga atu ia te ja, faapea foi le tao, ma le u fanafana, ma le tao so‘a iʻa.

verses.en: He esteemeth iron as straw, and brass as rotten wood.
verses.sm: Ua tusa ia te ia le uamea ma le ‘au o saito, o le “apa memea o le laau pala lea.

verses.en: The arrow cannot make him flee: slingstones are turned with him into stubble.
verses.sm: E le sola o ia i le u fanafana, o maa o le maatá e avea ia ma tagutugutu o saito la te ia.

verses.en: Darts are counted as stubble: he laugheth at the shaking of a spear.
verses.sm: Ua tusa ia te ia le uatogi ma tagutugutu O saito; ua ia ‘ata foi i le apoapo o le tao.

verses.en: Sharp stones are under him: he spreadeth sharp pointed things upon the mire.
verses.sm: Ua i ona lalo fasi ipu omea maamaai; na te fofolaina mea matuitui i luga o le palapala.

verses.en: He maketh the deep to boil like a pot: he maketh the sea like a pot of ointment.
verses.sm: Ua ia faapupuna le moana e pei o se ulo; ua ia fai le sami e pei o se ipu uu.

verses.en: He maketh a path to shine after him; one would think the deep to be hoary.
verses.sm: Ua ia faapupula le ala ua na tuanai; e manatu ai se tasi ua ulusina le moana.

verses.en: Upon earth there is not his like, who is made without fear.
verses.sm: E leai se tasi e tusa ma ia i luga o le laueleele, ina ua faia ua leai sona mata‘u.

verses.en: He beholdeth all high things: he is a king over all the children of pride.
verses.sm: Ua vaai ifo o ia i mea maualuluga uma; o ia o le tupu o manu feai uma lava.
